<style id="pda-v66-faction-themes">

<style id="pda-v67-atmosphere">

.v61-panel #v61-detailpage .v61-dossier-head{background:linear-gradient(95deg,rgba(8,13,12,.89),rgba(10,17,15,.74)),var(--v67-cover) center 48%/cover!important;position:relative;isolation:isolate;grid-template-columns:minmax(235px,38%) minmax(0,1fr)!important;grid-template-rows:34px 27px auto auto minmax(53px,auto)!important;grid-template-areas:'back back' 'art klass' 'art name' 'art crumb' 'art identity'!important;gap:5px 24px!important;min-height:237px;padding:15px!important;box-shadow:inset 0 0 100px #0008,0 18px 34px #0006;border:1px solid var(--f-edge)!important;border-bottom:3px solid var(--f-accent)!important;overflow:hidden}
